answer_text:
The **G-Wagon** (officially known as the **Mercedes-Benz G-Class**) is a **four-wheel drive luxury SUV**. Here's a breakdown of what makes it special:

### What It Is
The Mercedes-Benz G-Class, colloquially known as the G-Wagon or G-Wagen (as an abbreviation of *Geländewagen*), is a four-wheel drive luxury SUV sold by Mercedes-Benz.

### Its Origins
Originally developed as a military off-roader, later more luxurious models were added to the line. The G-Class was first introduced to the civilian market in 1979 and was officially offered in the U.S. starting with the 2002 model year.

### Key Characteristics
- The G-Class is characterized by its **boxy styling** and **body-on-frame construction**. It uses three fully locking differentials, making it one of the few passenger vehicles to have such a feature.
- Over the decades, it has earned a reputation for its **off-road capabilities**, iconic boxy design, and impeccable build quality.
- While Mercedes-Benz built the exterior of the G-Class for rugged adventures, it designed the interior for **luxury and comfort**.

### Popularity
Despite its high price, the G-Class has maintained a loyal following among enthusiasts who appreciate its timeless aesthetic and unparalleled off-road prowess, as well as buyers who simply love its head-turning looks.

In short, the G-Wagon is a **high-end, off-road capable luxury SUV** that blends rugged performance with premium comfort — making it one of the most iconic and recognizable vehicles in the world.
